name: Notion
shortDescription: Docs, wikis, and agents in a team workspace. Free to start; paid plans on their site.
longDescription: Notion is a workspace for docs and wikis, with agent features in the product. The pricing crawl included $0 alongside $10 and $20. AI features may sit on paid plans — confirm which agent features are on Free. We did not create a workspace.
pricingNotes: AI features may require paid Notion plans — confirm which AI/agent features are on Free.
freeTierNotes: Includes a trial of Notion AI.
bestFor: Team docs that you also want to query
notIdealFor: A dedicated meeting bot — see Granola for that job
strength: The free workspace plan includes a trial of Notion AI, and the next plan starts at $10 per month.
weakness: Notion AI on the free plan is a trial, not a confirmed ongoing allotment.
smokeTestNotes: No local install attempted (SaaS/desktop/extension or install not feasible without account).

useCaseFit.meetings-knowledge: Team workspace for docs and wikis, with a free plan that trials Notion AI.
useCaseFit.knowledge-qa: The pricing page lists a trial of Notion AI and says you can capture and organize responses in the workspace.
